desc:
💨 FART TOGETHER 💨 1-4 PLAYER CO-OP FART RAFT

Your raft has no engine, no sails and no paddles. The only way forward? Farting. 💨

Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends, jump on the raft and blast it through a deadly course. Every fart pushes the boat, so if your crew isn’t working together you’ll drift straight into spikes, traps and wild currents! 🌊

👥 1-4 PLAYERS: go solo or pick your crew in the lobby
💨 FART TO MOVE: every blast pushes the raft
🧭 STEER AS A TEAM: one bad fart sends you off course
⚠️ DODGE TRAPS & SPIKES: one wrong move and it’s over
🌀 FIGHT THE CURRENTS: the water is working against you

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for updates!
